text: No, there was no tree-cover loss on this property in 2026. The most recent observed loss occurred in 2025, affecting 13.5 hectares (3.9% of the asset). No later years in the series (up to 2025) confirmed additional loss, and there is no data available for 2026 in the datasets used. The event in 2025 was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference dataset, which mapped 98% of the affected area as forest in 2020.
